applied.fact: Which pitch is bolted (pitch_detail[2] says 'Fully bolted' with bolts:0; gear says to protect the reach)

pitch_detail.notes: Shares the start with Mourning Star, then trends about 20 ft right to Zoom is anchor.
About 70 ft. Blocky bolted climbing, traverses right under a small roof to a triangular belay ledge (often wet).
The Flake pitch, about 50 ft. Tricky and reachy off the belay, follows a flake system to the top. Fully bolted (added 2018-2019).
